description: List tools for task slugs, ordered by published fit weights, optionally for a sector. A role supplies its suggested tasks when taskSlugs is omitted. Get slugs from list_taxonomy or search_tools. Each listing includes the tool's own MCP server, if any; set mcp to keep only tools that connect to AI assistants.

mcp.description: Only tools whose own MCP server matches: yes, no, or a connection type (oauth = sign in with account, none = no sign-in, api-key, local).

sector.description: Sector slug. Limits results to tools that serve this sector and favours specialists.

taskSlugs.description: Task slugs. Required unless role is given.

name: recommend_tools
title: Recommend tools for work
